channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-games-of-coding
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: hackmud — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: Retro cyberpunk RPG where you play a digital persona in a chaotic, unpredictable, and often goofy abandoned internet.

item.title: claude-ball — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: You coach a 2D soccer team, but the tactics are your job, not the typing: you describe how the team should play in plain English and your AI coding agent writes the bot's brain in TypeScript (a CLAUDE.md keeps the agent to coding, never strategy). Matches are deterministic, and you submit your bot to a live ladder against built-in bots and everyone else's. Open source.

item.title: WebTerm Learn — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: Gamified courses for the Linux terminal, Git and Vim that run in a simulated terminal in the browser. Every lesson is a hex on a 3D adventure map, you type real commands, and the exercise checks the resulting state rather than the command you typed.

item.title: V5 Games — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: Browser-based AI text adventure games and word games, including AI-generated interactive fiction playable directly in the browser.

item.title: Tank Royale — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: Battle royale game built on Robocode where you program tanks in Java, Kotlin, C#, or Python to fight against other players' bots until only one remains.

item.title: Human Resource Machine — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: Puzzle game by Tomorrow Corporation where you program office workers with a small assembly-like language to move items from the inbox to the outbox.

item.title: DevOps Daily Games — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: Free browser simulators and terminal games for DevOps: run commands in Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform and SQL terminals, and work through load balancing, rate limiting, DNS and scaling scenarios.

item.title: CodeCityApp — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: Build a city by completing coding quests gated by passing tests, with a built-in AI mentor for contextual help.

item.title: Code4win — via awesome-games-of-coding
item.description: Browser-based programming game platform where you write code, solve simulation puzzles, optimize your solutions, and compete for the top spot on the leaderboard.
